what: Four metronome dots — the scrolled amount becomes the beat, only the current beat’s dot lights up and bounces at 1.18x in half a beat. Each time a measure (four beats) passes, the measure number and progress bar change in half a beat and the text (like a chord name) rises from 30% below

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)

use: ×4
